author: Pierre Cherbero
description: UploadDND provides a drag & drop upload interface for Rails apps, built on ActiveStorage, Stimulus and ViewComponent. It validates files server-side (MIME sniffing, size, count), supports temporary uploads for new records, and authorizes every request fail-closed through Pundit or CanCanCan.
